steps.prompt: Picture a geometry problem you got wrong recently. Did you draw a careful figure first?

cards.title: The geometry toolkit
cards.body: Always draw the figure, roughly to scale, and mark everything you know. Angles: a triangle adds to $180^\circ$, an inscribed angle is half its arc. Lengths: Pythagoras and its triples ($3$-$4$-$5$, $5$-$12$-$13$, $8$-$15$-$17$), similar triangles, power of a point. Areas: $\frac{1}{2}bh$, Heron, the shoelace formula. Solids: $V = \frac{1}{3}Bh$ for cones and pyramids, $\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3$ for a sphere.

cards.title: Worked example: draw it
cards.problem: A rectangle has diagonal $13$ and one side $5$. What is its area?

steps.text: The diagonal makes a right triangle: the other side is $\sqrt{169 - 25}$.

try.prompt: How long is the other side?

cards.title: Your fact sheets
cards.body: The Units 11 to 13 fact sheets hold every geometry formula from the course. Read them through once, and copy the three you forget most onto a card.

prompts: Which geometry formula goes on your card?
